extDescription.message: Rejects non-essential cookie consent banners and clears cookies automatically.

accessWarning.message: Migalhas needs access to all sites to list cookies and to protect open tabs. Turn it on in the extension's details (Site access: On all sites). Until then, the clean-up is paused.

cleanupSkipped.message: Clean-up skipped: Migalhas needs access to all sites.

sitesHint.message: On: cookies are kept. Off: cookies and other site data (such as localStorage) are deleted at the next clean-up, unless the site is open in a tab. New sites start switched off.

lockHint.message: Lock a site with its padlock so the switch can't change by accident.

bulkHint.message: The buttons apply to the sites shown, so you can search first. Locked sites are skipped.

lockedTitle.message: Locked: unlock to change this site

badgeRejected.message: Migalhas — $CMP$: banner rejected, necessary cookies only.

badgeLegitimateInterest.message: Note: the site still uses "legitimate interest" without consent (see the console, F12).

badgeLeftAlone.message: Migalhas — $CMP$: banner left alone (see the console, F12).

badgeFailed.message: Migalhas — $CMP$: the site saved more than necessary cookies (see the console, F12).
